business_problem: Tractian needed to turn terabytes of industrial sensor signals into real-time maintenance guidance at global scale, but legacy monitoring approaches left data trapped in clipboards, spreadsheets, and anomaly-only tools that could not explain failures or recommend next actions.
solution_summary: Tractian built a physical AI factory on NVIDIA’s stack to ingest machine telemetry, train multimodal models, and serve specialized maintenance agents at production scale. Its 4-in-1 sensors capture vibration, temperature, ultrasound, and RPM data from 200,000 machines, while NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries such as cuFFT accelerate the low-level signal processing that converts waveforms into anomaly indicators. The company trains multimodal models on 3.5 billion sensor samples across NVIDIA GB300 NVL72, H200, and H100 systems with NCCL, prototypes new models on NVIDIA DGX Spark, and then scales them to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure bare-metal GPU clusters orchestrated with Kubernetes. In production, NVIDIA TensorRT and NVIDIA Dynamo run 50 specialized agents for failure detection, severity classification, root cause analysis, repair guidance, and energy optimization across 500 GPUs.
products_used: NVIDIA GB300 NVL72, H200, and H100 systems
